'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Brian Fred LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Fred]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
